name: anime-mv-ref2v
title_zh: 让 MiniMax 照着角色图卡点出分镜的动漫 MV
tagline_zh: 给 MiniMax H3 写专业级动漫 MV/PV 提示词，角色图、音频、动态字、UI 特效全编排，卡点精准。
tagline_en: Craft pro-level prompts for MiniMax H3 ref2v: sync character images, audio, kinetic type, UI overlays into.
desc_en: Specialized prompt engineering and storyboard orchestration skill for creating anime Music Videos (MV) and Promotional Videos (PV) using MiniMax H3 Reference-to-Video (ref2va / r2v). Generates professional, audio-synced video prompts combining character image references ([Picture 1]), reference audio tracks ([Audio 1]), kinetic typography, motion graphics, UI/HUD overlays, and anime visual languag
why_zh: 不是简单翻译需求，而是把分镜节奏、转场、特效叠层都结构化，让 ref2v 模型吃透你的音乐和角色。
why_en: Structures storyboard rhythm, transitions, and FX layers so the model interprets your music and character refs into usable.
limit_zh: 只服务 MiniMax H3 的 ref2va/r2v 接口，不适用其他视频模型；需要你提供角色参考图和音频。
limit_en: Only for MiniMax H3 ref2va/r2v; needs your character image and audio; no final render or compositing.
